title: CNTRLPLANE-4936: Temporarily make deadcode advisory
body:
## What this PR does / why we need it:

Early PRs in a staged feature can introduce intentionally unreachable foundations whose production callers arrive later, as a contributor encountered in #9916. Make the deadcode scan step temporarily nonblocking with `continue-on-error: true`, keeping the strict scan command, logs, and existing report upload.

The workflow comment links [CNTRLPLANE-4936](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/CNTRLPLANE-4936), which tracks agreement on a policy for these cases and restoring mandatory enforcement. Update the development and CI documentation to describe the advisory period.

## Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

Related follow-up: https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/CNTRLPLANE-4936. The policy and restoration work remain outstanding after this temporary mitigation.

## Special notes for your reviewer:

Analyzer/build errors at the scan step are also nonblocking during this period. The report upload still uses `if: always()`; reports are available when the scan produces them.

The reusable workflow is resolved from `@main`, so this takes effect for PR checks after merging into `main` and rerunning them.

Validation: actionlint passed with the existing `arc-runner-set` custom runner label configured; `make docs-aggregate`, `make verify-docs-nav`, commit-layout verification, gitlint, pre-commit checks, and both pre-push hooks (`make verify-quick` and `make test-changed`) passed. Go unit tests and the full deadcode scan were not run for this workflow/documentation change.

## Checklist:

- [x] Subject and description added to both, commit and PR.
- [x] Relevant issues have been referenced.
- [x] This change includes docs.
- [ ] This change includes unit tests (not applicable to this workflow setting).
